literal_meaning: উঠানো বা নোট করা (raised or noted)
figurative_meaning_en: What has been noted or remembered
example_sentences_in_bangla: সব কথা তোলা আছে, ভুলবে না।
example_sentences_in_english: Everything is noted down, won't forget.
My name has been recorded in the list.
note: This idiom often refers to keeping a mental or written record in colloquial Bengali usage.
